reason: I work all week so it would only ever be a Saturday, and I'd pay $12 to try it once if the calm, designed space is really different from CoCo's. I would not sign up for a membership until I'd seen it myself.
objection: Isn't this just CoCo's Funhouse with nicer decor? I only get Saturdays, so $59 a month is more than I'd use, and four drop-ins cost less.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend-only or 4-visit pass around $35-40 a month, or a free trial visit or moms group event, so I can see it's actually calmer and cleaner than what we already go to.
